name: Systematic Reward Hacking and Prime Sprints
snippet:
May 20, 2026 — Detecting and mitigating reward hacking is one of the key challenges faced when scaling RL, particularly in semi-verifiable domains.
We release tunable RL templates that demonstrate reward hacking at 1B scale and introduce Prime Sprints, an open-access program with sponsored runs for community research.
